Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live"

Indian Standard 



SPECIFICATION FOR 
CUPS, VACUUM EXTRACTION (Reaffirmed1997) 



1. Scope — Dimansionai and other requirements for vacuum extraction cups used in obstetrics. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1 .

FIG. 1 CUP, VACUUM EXTRACTION 



2.1 A deviation of ±2'5 percent shall be allowed on all dimensions. 

3, Material 

3.1 Cups — Stainless steel conforming to Designation 04Cr18Ni10 or 07Cr18Ni9 of IS : 6911-1972 
' Specification for stainless steel plate sheet and strip '*. 

3.2 Chain — Stainless stee! conforming to Designation 30Cr13 of IS : 6603-1972 ' Specification for 
stainless steel bars and flats '. 

3.3 Rubber Tubing — Grade A of IS: 637-1965 'Specification for rubber tubings for general 
purposes ( revised) '. 

3.4 Other Components — Stainless steel conforming to Designation 30Cr13 of IS : 6603-1972. 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The cups and other components shall be free from burrs, pits, cracks, scales and other surface 
defects. 

4.2 The neck of the cup shall be rounded off and there shall be no sharp point on it. 

4.3 The cups shall be polished bright.

5. Tests 

g/l Strength of Chain — Clamp the cup in a suitable stand, apply a load of 500 N ( 50 kgf ) at the 
pin grip. The chain shall not break under load. 

5.2 Corrosion Resistance — Cups and other components made from stainless steel shall satisfy 
boiling and autoclaving test as specified in IS : 7531-1975 ' Method for boiling and autoclaving test 
for corrosion resistance of stainless steel surgical instruments'. 

6. Marking — Mark on a non-working surface with the manufacturer's name, initials or recognized 
trade-mark. 

6.1 ISI Certification Marking —Details available with the Indian Standards institution. 

7. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier taking care that cups are not 
damaged in transit.
